title: 第2308章 斩杀赵纪第2307章 妖族统领牛河
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
牛河的决定也是比较谨慎。
如果江尘无法对付这些异域的高层强者，那么妖族大军还能撤退。
如果江尘成功的话，那么妖族大军发起进攻。
对于牛河的决定，江尘没有异议。
很快，在牛河的安排下，妖族大军动员起来，做好出战的准备。
至于江尘，此时已经掌握了王尽与古可二人的方向。
一众妖族大军跟在后面。
牛河带着几名大乘境的大妖跟在江尘的身边。
两天后，妖族大军悄悄地靠近异域大军这儿。
此时离异域大本营有一千多里，妖族大军暂时在这儿等待。
至于沿途的一些探子，江尘等人已经将其抓住，控制起来了，让其无法通知异域大军那边，而且江尘没有将这些探子杀死，那些异域入侵者也不知道这些探子已经出事了。
“走。”
江尘带路。
牛河等几个大妖跟了上去。
一千多里的距离，对于江尘这些大乘境强者而言，只是很短的时间就能跨越。
前方，灯火通明，很多修士在四处巡逻。
江尘等人的出现，吓了这些大玄界的修士一跳。
“谁？”
一名巡逻队长大喝道。
突然，一记武技轰来，这支巡逻队还没有反应过来，身体瞬间崩碎。

这些巡逻队的实力，怎么可能挡得住大乘境强者？
“炎龙爆。”
江尘直接凝聚了一门武技，直接轰向眼前的大营。
一条千米的炎龙怒吼着朝异域大军的大营冲去。
此时，大营的防御大阵升起。
但是大营的屏障瞬间就被炎龙给击碎了，然后炎龙冲向大营中肆虐，很多修士还没有发出惨叫，就被炎龙的高温给化为灰烬了，所过之处，火海滚滚，这一招，起码有数千名修士被杀死。
如此一来，整个大营乱起来了。
“敌袭，敌袭。”
异域大营不停地有人高呼。
如此大的动静，当然惊动了大营的其他人。
牛河等几个大妖，也是跟着江尘杀进大营里，不停地攻击周围的异族。
牛河化为一头数十米高，一百多米长的巨型牛，横冲直撞，所过之处，很多修士直被撞死，踩死。
而且，地面一踩，周围的地面直接崩裂，大量的修士被这股强大的力量震死。
其他几头大妖，也是纷纷化为本体，对着周围的修士大杀特杀，整个营地死伤惨重。
短短时间内，估计有一万余人被杀死，被重伤。
“何人如此大胆，居然敢闯我们营地？找死。”
此时，一道怒喝声传来。
此人是一个大乘境七重的修士。
跟在他身后的，还有十几个大乘境强者。
“那些大乘境的存在，优先交给我来对付，我们之间说好的。”

江尘淡淡地道。
江尘说完，身影一闪，掠向这名大乘境七重的修士。
江尘动作如风，这名大乘境七重的强者跟着他身边的十几名大乘境高手，直接被打飞，鲜血狂喷，当场惨死。
江尘的力量，可不是他们能抵挡的，十几个尸体，直接朝地面落下，砸出一个个大坑。
content_en:
Ushikawa's decision was also more cautious.
If Jiang Chen can't deal with these high-level experts from foreign lands, then the demon army can still retreat.
If Jiang Chen succeeds, then the demon army will launch an attack.
Jiang Chen had no objection to Niu He's decision.
Soon, under Ushikawa's arrangement, the demon army mobilized and prepared for battle.
As for Jiang Chen, he had already grasped the direction of Wang Jin and Gu Ke.
An army of monsters followed behind.
Niu He led several great demons from the Mahayana realm to follow Jiang Chen.
Two days later, the demon army quietly approached the foreign army.
At this time, it is more than a thousand miles away from the foreign land base camp, and the demon army is waiting here for the time being.
As for some of the spies along the way, Jiang Chen and others had captured them and controlled them so that they could not notify the foreign army. Moreover, Jiang Chen did not kill these spies, and the foreign invaders did not know that something had happened to these spies.
"Let's go."
Jiang Chen led the way.
Ushikawa and several other large demons followed.
The distance of more than a thousand miles can be covered in only a short time for powerful Mahayana realm masters like Jiang Chen.
Ahead, the lights were bright and many monks were patrolling around.
The appearance of Jiang Chen and others shocked these Daxuan Realm monks.
"Who?"
A patrol captain shouted.
Suddenly, a martial arts attack came. Before the patrol could react, their bodies instantly shattered.
With the strength of these patrols, how could they possibly stop a powerful person from the Mahayana realm?
"Fire Dragon Explosion."
Jiang Chen directly gathered a martial skill and blasted directly towards the camp in front of him.
A thousand-meter-long flame dragon roared and charged towards the camp of the foreign army.
At this time, the defense formation of the camp was raised.
But the barrier of the camp was instantly shattered by the flame dragon, and then the flame dragon rushed into the camp and wreaked havoc. Many monks were reduced to ashes by the high temperature of the flame dragon before they could scream. The sea of ​​fire rolled wherever it passed. This move killed at least thousands of monks.
As a result, the entire camp was in chaos.
"Enemy attack, enemy attack."
People in the foreign camp kept shouting.
Such a big movement naturally alarmed other people in the camp.
Niu He and several other big monsters also followed Jiang Chen into the camp and kept attacking the surrounding aliens.
Niuhe turned into a giant bull that was tens of meters high and more than a hundred meters long. It ran rampantly. Many monks were hit and trampled to death wherever it passed.
Moreover, as soon as the ground was stepped on, the surrounding ground directly collapsed, and a large number of monks were killed by this powerful force.
Several other big demons also turned into their true bodies one after another, killing the monks around them. The entire camp suffered heavy casualties.
In a short period of time, it is estimated that more than 10,000 people were killed and seriously injured.
"Who is so bold as to break into our camp? He is seeking death."
At this time, an angry shout came.
This person is a monk at the seventh level of the Mahayana realm.
Behind him, there were more than a dozen powerful people in the Mahayana realm.
"Those entities in the Mahayana realm should be dealt with by me first, as we have agreed."
Jiang Chen said calmly.
After Jiang Chen finished speaking, his figure flashed towards this monk at the seventh level of the Mahayana Realm.
Jiang Chen's movements were like the wind. This strong man at the seventh level of the Mahayana realm, followed by more than a dozen Mahayana realm masters around him, was directly knocked away, blood spurted out, and he died tragically on the spot.
Jiang Chen's power was not something they could withstand. More than a dozen corpses fell directly to the ground, creating large craters.
